spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi Jordan, I’ve lost my debit card and need a replacement. I’m Eilidh Lindqvist.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Eilidh. I can help with that. Before I check your identity, I can see your current account balance is £684.27, and there was a £12.50 payment to North Pier Books yesterday. Is that the account you mean?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’ll just verify you now. Can you tell me your full date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And what’s the postcode?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That matches. I’ll block the lost card and arrange a replacement. The replacement will be sent to your registered address, and delivery usually takes five to seven working days. I can’t guarantee the exact arrival date.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, thanks. I’m glad I noticed it was missing.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll submit the replacement request now. I’ll also send you a secure message by 4 pm today confirming the card has been blocked and the request has been logged. If it hasn’t arrived after seven working days, reply to that message and I’ll follow it up.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: the old card will be blocked, a replacement will be sent to your registered address, and I’ll message you by 4 pm today with confirmation. Delivery usually takes five to seven working days. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. Thanks for sorting it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Eilidh. Is there anything else I can help with today?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: All right. Thanks for calling Thistle Bank, and take care.
